  $tabsWrapper.append($tabs);

  var usedIds = {};

  // Loop through each list item
  $container.find('.list-item').each(function () {

    // Wrap inner contents of list-item in a container
    if (!$item.find('.container').length) {

    (function wrapListItemImage() {
      var $innerContainer = $item.children('.container').first();
      if (!$innerContainer.length) return;

      // Prefer direct child image to avoid catching nested images in rich text
      var $img = $innerContainer.children('img.list-item-img').first();

      // Fallback if markup changes (still avoid wrapping images already wrapped)
      if (!$img.length) {
        $img = $innerContainer.find('> img.list-item-img').first();
      }

      if (!$img.length) return;

      // If already wrapped, do nothing
      if ($img.parent().hasClass('list-item-image-wrap')) return;

      $img.wrap('<div class="list-item-image-wrap"></div>');
    })();

    // Get heading text
    var headingText = $item.find('h2').first().text().trim();
    if (!headingText) return;

    // Generate unique slug ID
    var baseId = headingText
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/(^-|-$)/g, '');

    var id = baseId, n = 2;
    while (usedIds[id]) id = baseId + '-' + n++;

    // Insert mobile title button before each list-item
    var $mobileBtn = $('<button type="button" class="mobile-tab-title"></button>')

      .append(
        $('<span class="tab-text"></span>').text(headingText),
        $('<span class="toggle-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>')
      )
      .insertBefore($item);

    // Build desktop tab button
    var $tab = $('<li class="list-tab" role="presentation"></li>');
    var $btn = $('<button type="button" class="list-tab-btn" role="tab"></button>')
      .attr('aria-controls', id)
      .attr('aria-selected', 'false')

    $tabs.append($tab);

    // First item active by default (desktop + initial content)
    if (first) {

    $tabs.find('.list-tab-btn').attr('aria-selected', 'false');

    $(this).closest('.list-tab').addClass('active');
    $(this).attr('aria-selected', 'true');

    // Fade swap content
    $currentItem.stop(true, true).fadeOut(200, function () {
      $currentItem.removeClass('active');

      $newItem
        .stop(true, true)
        .addClass('active')

      $panel.removeClass('active').stop(true, true).slideUp(200);
    }

  });

function initAnchorLinks() {
	jQuery('a[href*="#"]')
	.not('[href="#"]')
	.not('[href="#0"]')
	.click(function(event) {
		console.log("click check 1");

		if (
			location.pathname.replace(/^\//, '') === this.pathname.replace(/^\//, '') &&
			location.hostname === this.hostname
		) {
			var target = jQuery(this.hash);
			target = target.length ? target : jQuery('[name=' + this.hash.slice(1) + ']');

			if (target.length) {
				event.preventDefault();

				// Get height of fixed header
				var headerHeight = jQuery('.header-nav').outerHeight() || 0;

				jQuery('html, body').animate({
					scrollTop: target.offset().top - (headerHeight+10)
				}, 800);
			}
		}
	});

	// Remove hash from URL on page load
	if (window.location.hash) {
        history.replaceState(null, null, window.location.pathname + window.location.search);
    }
	
	// Smooth scroll to anchor and remove hash from URL
	jQuery(document).on("click touchstart", 'a[href*="#"]', function (event) {
	    event.preventDefault();

	    console.log("click check 2");

	    const href = jQuery(this).attr("href");
	    const targetID = href.split("#")[1]; // Extract the anchor ID

	    if (targetID) {
	        const target = jQuery("#" + targetID);
	        if (target.length) {

	        	// Get height of fixed header
				var headerHeight = jQuery('.header-nav').outerHeight() || 0;

	            jQuery("html, body").animate(
	                { scrollTop: target.offset().top - (headerHeight + 10)},
	                500,
	                function () {
	                    // Remove hash from URL after scrolling
	                    history.replaceState(null, null, window.location.pathname + window.location.search);
	                }
	            );
	        }
	    }
	});

	//tab deep links
    jQuery(document).on("click touchstart", 'a[href*="?tab="]', function (event) {
	    event.preventDefault();

	    // Get the current URL without query parameters
	    const currentURL = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;

	    // Get the tab parameter from the clicked link
	    const href = jQuery(this).attr("href");
	    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(href.split("?")[1]);
	    const tabParam = urlParams.get("tab");

	    if (tabParam) {
	        // Construct the new URL with the tab parameter
	        const newURL = currentURL + "?tab=" + tabParam;

	        // Update the browser URL and reload the page
	        setTimeout(function () {
	            window.location.href = newURL;
	        }, 300);
	    }
	});

    // Check for ?tab= parameter on page load
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const tabParam = urlParams.get("tab");
    activateTabFromParam(tabParam);
}

function activateTabFromParam(tabParam) {
    if (tabParam) {
        const isMobile = window.innerWidth < 768; // Detect mobile view
        const tabID = isMobile 
            ? "[id^='tabpanel-" + tabParam.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-") + "']" 
            : "#tab-" + tabParam.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "-") + "-desktop";

        const $tab = jQuery(tabID);

        if ($tab.length) {
            $tab.trigger("click"); // Simulate tab activation

            // Find the closest section tag
            const $section = $tab.closest("section");

            // Ensure header height is accounted for
            const headerHeight = jQuery("#header-nav").outerHeight() || 0;

            // Scroll to the closest section or fallback to the tab
            setTimeout(() => {
                const targetOffset = $section.length ? $section.offset().top : $tab.offset().top;
                jQuery("html, body").animate(
                    { scrollTop: targetOffset - headerHeight - 20 },
                    500
                );
            }, 300);
        }
    }
}
